title.value: A general class of surrogate functions for stable and efficient reinforcement learning
title.justification: The title clearly indicates the main focus of the paper, which is the development of a new class of surrogate functions for reinforcement learning.
title.quote: A general class of surrogate functions for stable and efficient reinforcement learning

extractions.description: The paper proposes a framework called Functional Mirror Ascent for Policy Gradient (FMA-PG) that enables policy gradient methods in reinforcement learning to have strong theoretical guarantees for policy improvement, regardless of the policy parameterization. This framework generates a family of surrogate functions that provide these guarantees by using mirror ascent in the functional space of policies. The work includes theoretical contributions as well as experimental evaluations in various reinforcement learning tasks.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on developing a framework for reinforcement learning, which is a generic machine learning method. It primarily addresses the theoretical and methodological aspects of policy gradient methods without direct application to climate or ecological challenges.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We evaluate the performance of surrogate functions instantiated by FMA-PG on simple bandit and reinforcement learning settings.
